light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a helper with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the coop background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has in the evening: one warm bulb hanging from a rafter and the last daylight from the open door; correctly exposed. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, age spots and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases; feathers with real texture. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld video filmed by a helper with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural older hands; she moves naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

anchors.prompt: Same woman, early grey morning. Opal, a 68-year-old farm woman with grey hair pulled back in a loose low bun with stray strands, a navy blue long-sleeved cotton dress with a tiny pink and white flower print and small buttons, a grey and white pinstriped cotton pinafore apron over it, natural older skin with lines and age spots, no jewelry stands just inside the open door of the inside of her small red-painted wooden chicken coop on an Indiana farm: a row of wooden nest boxes with straw, pine shavings on the floor, wooden roost bars, a galvanized hanging feeder, a small window with chicken wire, daylight through the open door, an empty wicker egg basket on her arm, staring toward the back corner of the coop with a stunned, horrified face, one hand over her mouth. She wears the same navy blue flowered cotton dress with small buttons and the same grey and white pinstriped apron, grey hair pulled back in a loose low bun with stray strands.

A few seconds later, same place: she has knelt down on the straw and holds up a single red feather between her fingers toward the camera, wide-eyed, mouth open in shock. She wears the same navy blue flowered cotton dress with small buttons and the same grey and white pinstriped apron, grey hair pulled back in a loose low bun with stray strands.

Same place a few seconds later: still kneeling, she lowers the feather and looks at the camera with a sad, grim, determined face. She wears the same navy blue flowered cotton dress with small buttons and the same grey and white pinstriped apron, grey hair pulled back in a loose low bun with stray strands.

clips.text: Tuesday morning I opened the coop door, and three of my hens were dead.
clips.action: She stares at the back corner, stunned, then kneels down and picks up a red feather. She wears the same navy blue flowered cotton dress with small buttons and the same grey and white pinstriped apron, grey hair pulled back in a loose low bun with stray strands.

She holds up the red feather toward the camera, shocked, then lowers it with a grim face. She wears the same navy blue flowered cotton dress with small buttons and the same grey and white pinstriped apron, grey hair pulled back in a loose low bun with stray strands.
